description: This file contains a series of shell script test cases for a git repository, focusing on quarantine and access control behaviors during push operations. It defines tests to verify object rejection, acceptance, removal, cross-platform path handling, and reference update restrictions, utilizing test-lib.sh utilities for setup and assertions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success based on a provided shell script.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit, possibly with specific content or message.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares contents of two files or outputs, asserting equality.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for specific prerequisites or environment conditions.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up or tests git hook scripts.
